lessons.title: A King and His People
lessons.context: A short literary passage about a wise king.

paragraphs.dari: در زمان‌های قدیم یک پادشاه مردم خود را خیلی دوست داشت.
paragraphs.en: In old times a king loved his people very much.

paragraphs.dari: او هر ماه لباسش را عوض می‌کرد و در شهر می‌گشت تا زندگی مردم را ببیند.
paragraphs.en: He would change his clothes every month and walk through the city to see the people's lives.

paragraphs.dari: یک روز او دید که یک مرد پیر گرسنه نشسته است.
paragraphs.en: One day he saw an old man sitting hungry.

paragraphs.dari: پادشاه زود به وزیرانش امر کرد که به فقیران کمک شود.
paragraphs.en: The king quickly ordered his ministers that the poor be helped.

paragraphs.dari: به خاطر همین عدالت و شفقت، مردم هنوز هم این پادشاه را یاد می‌کنند.
paragraphs.en: Because of this same justice and compassion, people still remember this king.

questions.question: What would the king do every month?
options: Change clothes and walk through the city

questions.question: Why did he walk through the city?
What did he see one day?
Why do people still remember this king?

lessons.title: The Poet's Garden
lessons.context: A short literary passage about a poet finding inspiration.

paragraphs.dari: آن شاعر هر صبح در باغ خود می‌نشست و شعر می‌نوشت.
paragraphs.en: That poet would sit in his garden every morning and write verses.

paragraphs.dari: بوی گل‌ها و صدای پرنده‌ها به او فکرهای نو می‌داد.
paragraphs.en: The fragrance of flowers and the sound of birds gave him new ideas.

paragraphs.dari: جایی که کلمات تمام می‌شدند، او با خاموشی به طبیعت نگاه می‌کرد.
paragraphs.en: Where words ran out, he would watch nature in silence.

paragraphs.dari: شعرهایش ساده بودند، اما حکمت عمیق زندگی در آن‌ها پنهان بود.
paragraphs.en: His verses were simple, but life's deep wisdom was hidden within them.

paragraphs.dari: مردم می‌گفتند که باغ او نبود، بلکه قلبش خانه اصلی شعر بود.
paragraphs.en: People said that it was not his garden, but his heart that was poetry's true home.

questions.question: Where would the poet write verses every morning?
What gave him new ideas?
options: The fragrance of flowers and sound of birds

questions.question: What did his verses hold, according to the passage?
What did people say was poetry's true home?
